notes: Fake-clock bubble over threads (see the fake-runtime deviation). Traces of sleeps, waits, goroutines and channels are compared with Go's synctest by tools/testing_check.py.

Sleep.note: A bubble is an explicit mechanism, not runtime support: threads started with synctest::spawn join it, the bubble has its own fake clock (synctest::now) advanced only when every thread is asleep in time_sleep/sleep, waiting in wait, or receiving from an empty synctest::Chan. crate::time and crate::context timers, std channels and Condvar keep real time and are not durably blocking, which Go's runtime would make automatic.

Test.note: A bubble is an explicit mechanism, not runtime support: threads started with synctest::spawn join it, the bubble has its own fake clock (synctest::now) advanced only when every thread is asleep in time_sleep/sleep, waiting in wait, or receiving from an empty synctest::Chan. crate::time and crate::context timers, std channels and Condvar keep real time and are not durably blocking, which Go's runtime would make automatic. Cleanup functions run inside the bubble; T.run, T.parallel and T.deadline panic; a deadlock fails the test.
